name: Hooked on Destruction
caption: 'Psycho' Vicki V and Christy Cooper, who carried the WCA World Tag Team Championship into 1997 and retained it twice in January.

tenures.role: World Tag Team Champions into January 1997

name: the Bounty Hunters
caption: Won the WCA World Tag Team Championship in a four-team mini-tournament, 21 April 1997, after the previous champions no-showed and vacated the belts.

tenures.role: World Tag Team Champions from 21 April
